definition: the project's step-chain flow config — DATA, not code (requirements-spec AC-3, flow-control-spec v6 §7, core-design §6). chains maps a WORK TYPE to its chain ENTRIES; a task's contract.workType selects it, 'default' applies otherwise; an EMPTY chain = the task runs the lifecycle only (execution tasks — the runner does the work, outcomes arrive as observed evidence commits). A task's contract.flow overrides all. v3: an entry is {id, inputs?: {role → source}, params?, at?: 'grill'|'confirm'|'execute', verdict?: {decision → {gate, feedback?}}, when?} — the GATE SOURCE is data, the gate set and positions are not. A bare string id is the short form of {id}. The engine reads this file and never overrides it; the builtin fallback is the EMPTY chain. v4 (shaping): the idea→spec phase is SHAPING; the default chain is CONDITIONAL — the grill's verdict carries the depth (clear vs ambiguous, both accept; revise/reject reject), so a small/clear solid idea skips the vision and runs straight to a light spec, while an ambiguous idea still runs vision then spec. Requires flow.conditionals: true (set in rules/config/default.json).
template: shaping: idea → idea-validate (grill) → [vision when the grill deems the idea ambiguous] → spec — depth is the grill's call, so a clear idea reaches a light spec with no vision; execution tasks run the lifecycle (work-type chains)
